svg.title: Request to release workflow
svg.desc: Proposed DADS5250 solo project design by Satoshi Nakamura. The MVP prepares validated changes for human approval; live integration and production release are stretch goals.

rect.style: stroke: none; stroke-linecap: butt; stroke-width: 1; fill: rgb(100%,100%,100%); fill-rule: evenodd;

text.style: font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-weight: bold; font-size: 24px;fill: rgb(9%,12%,16%); stroke:none;
font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 10.5px;fill: rgb(32%,38%,45%); stroke:none;

g.text: Planned business workflow | One revenue metric request in one sample repository

text.style: font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 10.5px;fill: rgb(9%,12%,16%); stroke:none;

g.text: MVP: manual CSV intake, proposed changes, validation and a human decision.
